clue.text: Former president is about to pursue theory of nuclear deterrence

indicators.note: to pursue is to come after, so the later pieces follow the deterrence theory

parts.note: MAD stands for Mutually Assured Destruction, the Cold War doctrine of deterrence
on means about or concerning, as in a talk on art

explanation.surface: An ex-president is about to champion the doctrine of nuclear deterrence.
explanation.definitionFit: James Madison was the fourth President of the United States, so he is a former holder of the office.

clue.text: Pacifist slogan, kind which turns little people into doves

definitions.meaning: the anti-war rallying cry of the 1960s peace movement

definitions.text: kind which turns little people into doves
definitions.meaning: read as an instruction, it swaps the letters WAR for O (a ... score in tennis), so DWARVES, little people, become DOVES, birds of peace

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is an instruction on letters: in DWARVES replace WAR with O, which is love (zero in tennis), and you get DOVES.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase was the best-known chant of 1960s anti-Vietnam War protesters, a call for peace.

clue.text: Mate is scheduled to be treated for infection of limbs and trunk

indicators.note: treating something works it over, so these letters are processed into a new order

explanation.surface: A friend is booked in for treatment of an infection affecting arms, legs and torso.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Limbs and trunk' paints a human patient, but they are a tree's branches and trunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Dutch elm disease is a fungal blight that attacks the branches and trunks of elm trees.

clue.text: Online administrators are revolting bunch, protected by bodyguards

indicators.note: something protected by guards is surrounded by them, so the bunch sits inside the bodyguards

parts.note: the SS was originally Hitler's bodyguard unit

indicators.note: revolting means turning over, so in this down clue the bunch of flowers is read upwards

parts.note: a posy is a small bunch of flowers

explanation.surface: Website admins are a rebellious lot, shielded by minders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolting' looks like an insult aimed at the administrators, but it signals turning the bunch over in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Sysops, short for system operators, are the people who run online bulletin boards and servers.

clue.text: See 1
Meter inspector originally reported covering of dial in taxi

parts.note: M is the standard abbreviation for metre or meter

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the following word
reported means spoken of, so the sound of the covering is what goes in

parts.note: dial is slang for face, and a niqab is a veil covering the face

explanation.surface: A taxi meter inspector reported on the cover of the dial in a cab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dial' is slang for face, so its covering is a NIQAB, which sounds like NICAB.
explanation.definitionFit: A minicab is a car for hire that must be booked by phone, a kind of taxi.

clue.text: Manxman throwing up most of medicine for water-borne illness

parts.note: a Manx cat has no tail, so a Manx man is a male lacking its last letter

indicators.note: throwing up in a down clue means the letters are sent upwards, read in reverse
most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a remedy is a medicine or cure

explanation.surface: A man from the Isle of Man vomits after taking too much medicine for his seasickness.
explanation.walkthrough: Manx cats are tailless, so 'Manxman' is MALE without its tail. REMED (REMEDY less Y) thrown up gives DEMER.
explanation.definitionFit: Mal de mer is French for seasickness, an illness brought on by travelling over water.

clue.text: Teller and Oppenheimer disheartened after leaders of nuclear authority reveal traitor

indicators.note: after places the Oppenheimer piece behind the other letters
leaders are the first letters of the words that follow

parts.note: a rat is a betrayer or informer

indicators.note: disheartened here means having the whole middle removed, leaving only the outside letters

explanation.surface: Edward Teller and Robert Oppenheimer are dismayed when nuclear chiefs expose a spy.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Teller testified against Robert Oppenheimer, who led the atomic bomb project; here 'Teller' simply means one who tells a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrator is one who tells a story, so a teller in the storytelling sense.

clue.text: Cameron puts one to work, cutting higher element of tax at the same time

indicators.note: to work something is to knead or rearrange it, so the letters before it are reshuffled
cutting tells us one letter is taken out of the mixed pool
in a down clue the higher element of a word is its top, the first letter

explanation.surface: The Prime Minister gets someone working while slashing the top tax rate.
explanation.walkthrough: Mix CAMERON PUTS ONE TO, then take out T, the top of 'tax' in this down clue; David Cameron was Prime Minister in 2012.
explanation.definitionFit: Contemporaneous means existing or happening during the same period, simultaneous.

clue.text: Part of sermon offering solace to arms manufacturers, we hear

definitions.meaning: a line from the Beatitudes in the Sermon on the Mount

definitions.text: offering solace to arms manufacturers, we hear
definitions.meaning: spoken, the words suggest piece makers, gunsmiths making firearms, being called blessed; the Colt Peacemaker is a revolver

explanation.walkthrough: A 'piece' is slang for a gun, so said aloud the beatitude seems to bless those who make guns.
explanation.definitionFit: The Beatitudes, which open the Sermon on the Mount, include the words blessing those who make peace.

clue.text: Classic Loach film about sex and birds

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the film title goes round the other piece

parts.note: Kes is Ken Loach's 1969 film about a boy and his kestrel
it is a coy word for sex

explanation.surface: Ken Loach's classic film is about sex and birds.
explanation.walkthrough: Kes is about a boy training a kestrel, so 'birds' fits the surface too; the kites are the birds of prey.
explanation.definitionFit: Kites are birds of prey of the hawk family, such as the red kite.

clue.text: Capacity to endure retro rock band in semi-conscious state

indicators.note: in places the band's letters inside the dreamy state

parts.note: a trance is a half-conscious state

indicators.note: retro means backwards, so the band's name is read in reverse

parts.note: ELO is the Electric Light Orchestra

explanation.surface: Being able to sit through a revival rock band requires a dazed frame of mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolerance is the ability to put up with hardship or bear something unpleasant.

clue.text: See 8
Norwegian group supports gay star active in non-violent resistance

indicators.note: in a down clue a piece that supports another sits beneath it
active means lively and moving, so these letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: A-ha is the Norwegian pop band behind Take On Me

explanation.surface: A Norwegian band backs a gay celebrity who campaigns for peaceful protest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gay star active' rearranged gives SATYAGR, with AHA below it.
explanation.definitionFit: Satyagraha was Gandhi's philosophy of passive political resistance.

clue.text: Call by leaders disposed to form union

indicators.note: the leaders, the opening letters of both words, are thrown away

explanation.surface: A summons from the bosses to set up a trade union.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop the first letters of 'Call' and 'by' to leave ALL and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: To ally is to join together in alliance, which is to unite.

clue.text: Made good, clever move — invested in vibrator

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, so the clever move goes within the vibrator

parts.note: a reed vibrates to make the sound in a woodwind instrument
a coup is a brilliant or successful stroke

explanation.surface: A risqué boast that a smart purchase in a sex toy paid off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vibrator' points the surface somewhere racy, but it is the REED of a clarinet or oboe.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoup is to recover losses, so to have recouped is to have made good.

clue.text: Nitwit is detained by Her Majesty in enclosed place

indicators.note: detained means held inside, so the word is goes within the nitwit

parts.note: a clot is a fool
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: A fool is held at Her Majesty's pleasure in a secure place.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloister is a covered walk enclosing a monastery courtyard, a secluded place.

clue.text: Blue Caps from Connaught, exceptionally rugged and unusually slim

indicators.note: caps are the tops of words, which in a down clue are their first letters

parts.note: lean means thin or slim

explanation.surface: Blue caps from Connaught are exceptionally rugged and unusually slim.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerulean is a deep sky-blue colour.

clue.text: Idiosyncratically vocalised exclamation directed back and forth

indicators.note: and forth means it then appears again reading forwards

parts.note: yo is an informal shout of greeting

indicators.note: back tells us the word for directed is first read in reverse

parts.note: led means directed or guided
led means directed or guided

explanation.surface: A quirky shout was sent to and fro.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Directed back and forth' gives one word twice: DEL (LED backwards) then LED.
explanation.definitionFit: To yodel is to sing with rapid switches between chest voice and falsetto, a distinctive way of using the voice.

clue.text: Expression of cold British basic school skills

parts.note: the three Rs are reading, writing and arithmetic

explanation.surface: A chilly British take on the three basics of schooling.
explanation.definitionFit: Brrr is the sound people make when shivering, an interjection showing they feel chilly.

clue.text: Practitioner of 12 imprisoned by Goering and Hitler

indicators.note: imprisoned by means held inside, so the letters sit within these words

explanation.surface: A man of peace is jailed by the two leading Nazis.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahatma Gandhi developed and practised satyagraha, the non-violent resistance at 12.

clue.text: Lawrence takes shelter from oddly rainy day in Arabian city

indicators.note: in a down clue the Lawrence piece shelters beneath the other letters
oddly picks the first, third, fifth and seventh letters

parts.note: DH Lawrence, the English novelist

explanation.surface: Lawrence of Arabia ducks out of a wet day in a desert city.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests T. E. Lawrence of Arabia, but the initials here are D. H. Lawrence's.
explanation.definitionFit: Riyadh is the capital of Saudi Arabia.

clue.text: Body language betrayed canoeist's guilt

indicators.note: betrayed suggests something given away in disguise, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Gestures gave away the paddler's guilty conscience.
explanation.definitionFit: Gesticulations are expressive movements of the hands and arms, a form of non-verbal communication.

clue.text: See 1
A quiet heart broken by primitive impulses in racist regime

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the id is Freud's term for the instinctive part of the mind

explanation.surface: A gentle heart crushed by base instincts in a bigoted government.
explanation.definitionFit: Apartheid was South Africa's system of racial segregation, enforced by the government until 1994.

clue.text: Infinitely surpassing love right from the start

indicators.note: infinitely is read as without end, so the final letter goes

parts.note: above means higher than or surpassing
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: Something is far better than love from the very beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Ab ovo is Latin for from the egg, meaning from the very beginning.

clue.text: Flaneur insistently embracing Welshman

indicators.note: embracing means holding within, so the name sits inside these words

explanation.surface: A persistent idler hugs a man from Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Aneurin is a Welsh man's name, as in Aneurin Bevan, founder of the NHS.

clue.text: Desperate Athenians writing off 50% of loan with great speed

indicators.note: desperate suggests wild and frantic, so these letters are thrown into a new order
writing off means cancelling, so some letters are taken out of the mixed pool
fifty percent takes half of the word, here its second half

explanation.surface: Debt-ridden Greeks have half a loan cancelled in a rush.
explanation.walkthrough: The 2012 surface alludes to the Greek debt crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something hastily means doing it quickly, with great speed.
